newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Regional Russian telecoms may seek listing abroad.
newsitem.headline: Regional Russian telecoms may seek listing abroad.

text.p: Several regional Russian telecommunications companies are preparing to list their shares on international markets this year, Telecommunications Minister Vladimir Bulgak told a news conference on Wednesday.
"Several companies... are preparing listings on international markets," he said.

He named Perm, Kuban and Moscow as regions interested in listing shares abroad, but did not make clear if listings would be through American Depositary Receipts, which allow ADRs allow foreign investors to buy a company's shares while avoiding domestic settlement problems.
